name: Duk Guk  Authenitc Korean Rice Cake And Beef Soup
instructions: Fill a large pot with the water and stir in the salt and add the beef
As the beef is boiling , foam will rise up to the top of the pot
Simply scrape it off with a shallow , large spoon and dump into a bowl
Add the duk , dashida , sesame oil , garlic , and soy sauce and boil 15 more minutes
Add all the other ingredients and heat about 5 more minutes
Traditionally topped with carrot strips , fried egg cut into strips , and kim
